promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want to create…
pickInput: Select an input to finish connecting.
pickOutput: Select an output to finish connecting.
empty: Add a node to start your workflow.
nodeKeyboard: Press Enter to select this node. Use arrow keys to move it.
edgeKeyboard: Select a connection to disconnect it.

errors.missingNode: One of these nodes was removed. Select the nodes again.
errors.invalidTarget: Connect this output to the input of an image generator.
errors.self: Choose a different node to connect to.
errors.cycle: This connection would create a loop. Choose another input.
errors.missingPrompt: Connect a prompt node and enter a description before generating.
errors.emptyPrompt: Enter a description in the connected prompt node.
errors.missingImage: Choose an image or run the connected generator first.
errors.unsupportedImages: Choose a model that accepts reference images, or disconnect the image inputs.
errors.tooManyImages: This model accepts fewer reference images. Disconnect some image inputs and try again.
errors.desktopOnly: Open the desktop app to generate images.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save this workflow on this device.
errors.pickFailed: Could not open the image picker.
errors.providerSetup: Configure an image provider for this model in Settings.
errors.uncertain: The request outcome is unknown. Check generation history. Starting another run may incur a second charge.
errors.noImage: The completed job has no image.
